PR title:
Fix rendering of Enum choices' default

PR body:
This PR fix (and test) the rendering of a variety of `Enum`-based choices. Specifically their default value in the help/usgae screen.

Additionally, it adds a couple of unit tests to lock-in and document the current behavior of choices.

Refs:
 - #2911
- #2928

Gold patch (use only to infer the symptom; do not quote or describe the fix):
diff --git a/CHANGES.rst b/CHANGES.rst
index efa23d34..e0f7037e 100644
--- a/CHANGES.rst
+++ b/CHANGES.rst
@@ -8,9 +8,12 @@ Unreleased
 -   Fix reconciliation of `default`, `flag_value` and `type` parameters for
     flag options, as well as parsing and normalization of environment variables.
     :issue:`2952` :pr:`2956`
+-   Use the value of ``Enum`` choices to render their default value in help
+    screen. Refs :issue:`2911` :pr:`3004`
 -   Fix completion for the Z shell (``zsh``) for completion items containing
     colons. :issue:`2703` :pr:`2846`
 
+
 Version 8.2.1
 -------------
 
diff --git a/src/click/core.py b/src/click/core.py
index 445460bc..4bebb778 100644
--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -2872,6 +2872,8 @@ class Option(Parameter):
                 default_string = f"({self.show_default})"
             elif isinstance(default_value, (list, tuple)):
                 default_string = ", ".join(str(d) for d in default_value)
+            elif isinstance(default_value, enum.Enum):
+                default_string = default_value.name
             elif inspect.isfunction(default_value):
                 default_string = _("(dynamic)")

message.content: When an option uses an `Enum` as its type and has a default value, the help screen displays the wrong representation of that default.
